spots.text: The miller's ledger. Every day the same entry: Ground nothing. Water high. Still turning.

secrets.name: The Mill House
secrets.text: Behind the wheel, off a ledge the paddles nearly brush, the mill house door. Inside, the axle turns a pair of stones that grind nothing; a sack by the wall is full of loose letters, all the ones the water washed out of the books.

meta.label: The Mill Race
meta.blurb: The wheel turns, and the shelves on it go down into the water full and come up full and dripping, and none of the books is ever taken out. There is a smell of wet paper and of rivers.
